translation: The Blessed Lord said: To you who are entirely free from the taint of envy or cavil (anasuyave), I shall now unfold this most profound, secret wisdom (guhyatamam) along with its empirical realization. Mastering this science, you will be completely liberated from all degrading delusion.

This is the Sovereign Science, the Sovereign Secret, the ultimate Purifier of human consciousness. It can be directly verified through internal perception (pratyaksha-avagamam), it is in perfect harmony with righteousness, exceptionally joyful to practice, and immortal in its results.

Those human beings who lack faith in this righteous science, O scorcher of foes, fail to reach Me and remain trapped, tumbling repeatedly along the painful paths of this death-bound world (mrityu-samsara-vartmani).

This entire universe is pervaded and stretched out by Me through My unmanifest form (avyakta-murtina). All created entities reside and have their footing within Me, yet I do not depend on them or sit contained within them.

And yet, look at the grand paradox: these created entities do not permanently alter or constrain My reality. Behold My majestic, divine mystery (yogam-aishvaram)! My cosmic Presence is the absolute Sustainer of all entities (bhuta-bhrit) and the Source of all creation, yet it remains completely unattached, never localized inside them.

Just as the powerful, roaring wind moves everywhere across the globe while remaining dynamically suspended within the vast, silent embrace of space (akasha-sthitah), understand that all created entities are suspended within Me in the exact same manner.

At the end of a grand cosmic era (kalpa-kshaye), O son of Kunti, all manifest entities dissolve back into My primordial nature. And at the dawn of a fresh cycle, I project them forth once more into visibility.
Governing and energizing My material nature, I project forth again and again this entire collective multitude of entities, which is otherwise helpless, bound by the operational laws of nature.
And these monumental cosmic actions do not bind or limit Me in any way, O Dhananjaya! I remain seated above these operations like an unmoving, non-attached observer (udasina-vad- asinam).

Under My sovereign supervision (maya-adhyakshena), material nature brings forth the entire cosmos with all its moving and unmoving entities. By this underlying mechanism, O son of Kunti, the wheel of the universe rotates continuously.

Fools mock and look down upon Me when I assume a physical human body to carry out a mission, because they are completely blind to My supreme, transcendent reality as the absolute Sovereign of all existence.

Their expectations are futile, their actions are useless, their theoretical knowledge is completely vain, and their minds are entirely disorganized. They trap themselves inside the highly deceptive, brutal, and demonic nature (asurim prakritim), which values only predatory exploitation.

But the magnificent, expanded souls (Mahatmanah), O Partha, taking refuge securely within My divine, noble nature (daivim prakritim), serve Me with pure, single-minded focus, recognizing Me as the imperishable Source of all existence.
Constantly celebrating My glory, striving with iron-clad determination, bowing down before My presence with deep devotion, they worship Me daily, permanently integrated in Yoga.

Others worship Me by offering the sacrifice of knowledge (Jnana-yajna), contemplating Me as the One absolute Unity (ekatvena), as the distinct varieties of creation (prithaktvena), or as the multi-faced Cosmic Presence looking out from all sides (vishvato-mukham).

I am the specific Vedic ritual; I am the grand social sacrifice; I am the ancestral offering (svadha); I am the healing herb; I am the sacred chant; I am the clarified butter; I am the consuming fire; and I am the act of pouring the oblation.

I am the Father of this universe, the Mother, the Sustainer, and the ancient Grandfather. I am the ultimate object to be known, the holy Purifier, the sacred syllable Om, and I am the Rig, Sam, and Yajur Vedas.

I am the final Destination, the Sustainer, the Sovereign Lord, the inner Witness, the ultimate Abode, the ultimate Refuge, and the unselfish Friend. I am the creation, the dissolution, the underlying ground, the secure treasure-house, and the imperishable Seed.
I radiate heat as the sun, O Arjuna; I withhold and pour down the rain. I am immortality, and I am death personified. I am the manifest reality (Sat), and I am the unmanifest potential (Asat).

Those who are technical experts in the literal rituals of the three Vedas, drinking the symbolic Soma juice and filtering away their crude sins, worship Me through sacrifices merely to beg for a passage to heaven (svargatim). Reaching the prosperous world of Indra as the reward for their superficial merit, they feast upon the celestial pleasures of the gods.
simple_explanation: Krishna exposes the bankruptcy of transactional religion. Chanting holy formulas merely to secure a luxurious life in a heavenly resort is an abuse of spiritual science. It keeps a human being trapped in a cycle of commercial calculation.

translation: Having luxuriously consumed the pleasures of that vast heavenly paradise, the moment their accumulated merit is completely exhausted, they tumble back down into this mortal earth. Thus, following the transactional mechanics of the ritual texts, driven by shifting desires (kama-kamah), they gain nothing but an endless, exhausting loop of going and returning (gatagatam).

But to those rare individuals who worship Me with pure, single-minded focus, contemplating nothing else besides My divine reality, and who remain permanently integrated with Me day and night, I personally take over the complete responsibility of securing their spiritual progress and preserving their worldly well-being (yoga-kshemam vahamyaham).

Even those devotees who offer sacrifices to lesser deities with full faith, are actually worshiping Me alone, O son of Kunti, though they do so through an incorrect, short-sighted understanding of cosmic laws (avidhi-purvakam).
For I am the sole Recipient and the absolute Lord of all sacrifices. But because they fail to perceive My universal reality in its true essence, they inevitably fall away from the path of liberation.

Those who dedicate their vows to limited cosmic forces merge into those cosmic forces; those devoted to ancestral lineages join the ancestors; those who worship nature-spirits go to those entities; but My worshipers ascend straight into My absolute reality.

Whoever offers Me with pure devotion a simple leaf, a common flower, a piece of fruit, or a drop of water—I gladly accept that offering from the pure-hearted practitioner, because it is delivered with a clean spirit of love.
simple_explanation: This verse thoroughly democratizes spiritual life. The Divine demands no multi-million dollar rituals, no complex architecture, and no elite priestly middlemen. The poorest individual can achieve absolute union with God using whatever basic elements are available in nature, provided his heart is clean.

translation: Whatever action you execute, whatever food you consume, whatever rituals you perform, whatever charity you distribute, and whatever self-discipline you practice, O son of Kunti, dedicate it all as an offering unto Me (tat kurushva mad-arpanam).

Acting in this manner, you will be completely liberated from the binding shackles of karma, whether they carry pleasant or unpleasant consequences. With your heart fully integrated in the Yoga of renunciation, you will win absolute freedom and ascend to Me.

I look upon all living creatures with a completely equal, impartial eye; absolutely no one is loathsome to Me, and no one is uniquely favored. But those who serve Me with deep devotion reside securely within My awareness, and I manifest directly within their hearts.

Even if a person of highly wicked conduct turns to serve Me with pure, single-minded focus, he must be evaluated as righteous and noble (sadhur-eva), because he has made an absolute, correct steel resolve to transform his life.
He swiftly transforms into a deeply righteous soul and secures everlasting peace. Proclaim it boldly to the world, O son of Kunti, that My devotee is never destroyed or lost to decay!

Taking absolute refuge in Me, O Partha, even those who have been marginalized by birth or historical social prejudice—women, merchants, and laborers—can easily ascend to the supreme, absolute Destination.
simple_explanation: Krishna strikes a heavy blow against hereditary caste chauvinism. In the eyes of the Divine Law, there are no elite gatekeepers based on bloodlines. Spiritual illumination is a universal human right open to everyone.

translation: How much more certain is it then for virtuous scholars and dedicated royal sages (Rajarshiyah)! Therefore, finding yourself stationed within this transient, friction-ridden world, focus your life entirely upon Me.

Saturate your mind with My presence; become My dedicated devotee; dedicate all your sacrifices to Me; bow down before My universal presence. Having integrated your inner self in this manner and looking upon Me as your supreme refuge, you will come straight to Me.
